grammar.topic: Reported speech: questions (asked if / whether / where)
explainTr: Soruyu aktarırken soru yapısı kaybolur: cümle düz sıraya döner ve do/does/did kullanılmaz. 'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived. 'Where did you live' demezsin.
Evet/hayır sorularında if veya whether gelir: 'Is he sick?' → She asked if he was sick. Wh- sorularında soru kelimesi kalır: what, where, when, why, how.
Fiil bir adım geçmişe kayar (is → was, can → could, did → had + V3). Dolaylı soru nokta ile biter, soru işareti gerekmez.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Nerede yaşıyorsun diye sordu' derken soru sırasını koruyoruz gibi hissederiz. İngilizcede 'She asked where I lived' dersin: do/did yok, özne fiilden önce.
table: "Where is the office?" → She asked where the office was.
"Is he absent?" → She asked if he was absent.
"Do you work?" → She asked if I worked.
"Can you help?" → He asked if I could help.

exercises.q: "Where do you live?" → She asked me where I ___.
exercises.whyTr: Dolaylı soruda düz cümle sırası kullanılır ve fiil geçmişe kayar: where I lived.

exercises.q: "Is Emre sick?" → The nurse asked if Emre ___ sick.
exercises.whyTr: Dolaylı soruda soru sırası bozulur: if + özne + fiil (was).

options: He asked me what time did the bus leave.
He asked me what time left the bus.
He asked me what time the bus does leave.
He asked me what time the bus left.
exercises.whyTr: Dolaylı soruda do/did kullanılmaz: what time the bus left.

exercises.answer: She asked me if I had a pen
He wanted to know where the office was
exercises.whyTr: Wh- kelimesi + özne + fiil (soru sırası yok).

exercises.q: "Can you help me?" → She asked whether I ___ help her.
"Did you finish the form?" → He asked me if I ___ finished the form.
exercises.whyTr: Past Simple sorusu dolaylı anlatımda genelde Past Perfect olur: had finished.

exercises.q: "Why are you late?" → The principal asked why I ___ late.
exercises.whyTr: are/am → was ve soru sırası yok: why I was late.

exercises.q: The mother asked ___ her son was behaving well.
exercises.whyTr: Evet/hayır sorularını aktarırken if veya whether kullanılır, 'that' değil.

exercises.q: The parent ___ me that she was worried about her daughter.
exercises.whyTr: Bilgi cümlesi: told me that. Soru olsaydı asked me if/whether olurdu.

exercises.q: "Do you like the school?" → He asked me ___ I liked the school.
exercises.whyTr: Evet/hayır sorusunda if veya whether gelir.

exercises.q: "Where does she work?" → He asked where she ___.
exercises.whyTr: Where she worked: Past Simple, soru sırası yok.

reading.title: Mrs. Rivera's questions
reading.text:
On Wednesday afternoon, Mr. Brown stepped out of the front office for a few minutes, and Hafsa stayed at the desk. A woman came in. She was Mrs. Rivera, the mother of a third grader named Daniel.

"Hello," Mrs. Rivera said. "I have a few questions." She asked where Mr. Walker's classroom was. Then she asked whether Daniel had been absent last week. Hafsa checked the attendance list. "Yes, he missed one day," she said.

Mrs. Rivera looked a little worried. She asked if Daniel's behavior had changed lately. Hafsa did not know the answer, so she said, "I am only the substitute today, but I can write your questions down for his teacher." Mrs. Rivera was happy about that.

Hafsa took a piece of paper. Mrs. Rivera asked how Daniel was doing in reading, and she wanted to know if the school offered extra help. She also asked when the next parent-teacher conference was.

When Mr. Brown came back, Hafsa explained everything. "Mrs. Rivera asked where the classroom was, and she asked if Daniel had been absent. She also wanted to know when the conference was."

"Good work," Mr. Brown said. "The conference is on October 20. I will email her."

Hafsa felt proud. She was learning how a school really works.

questions.q: Why did Hafsa stay at the front desk?
options: Mr. Brown stepped out for a few minutes.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Mr. Brown stepped out of the front office'.

questions.q: What did Mrs. Rivera ask about Daniel's attendance?
options: Whether he had a new teacher
Whether he had been absent last week
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'whether Daniel had been absent last week'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa do when she did not know an answer?
options: She told Mrs. Rivera to leave.
She wrote the questions down for the teacher.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'I can write your questions down for his teacher'.

questions.q: When is the next parent-teacher conference?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'The conference is on October 20'.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hafsa, did anyone call while I was in the meeting?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, a parent called. Her name was Mrs. Cole.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: She asked what time dismissal was on Friday.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: It is at 1:00 on Friday. Did she ask anything else?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. She asked if her son could take his allergy medicine at school.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hmm. She needs to talk to the nurse about that.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I told her that. She also wanted to know whether the bus ran on Friday.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes, it runs at the normal time. Is that all?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: She asked how she could contact the teacher. I gave her the school email.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Perfect. Did you get her phone number?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, it is on this paper. She said that she was home after four.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Great. I will call her back this afternoon. Thanks for your help.

questions.q: What did Mrs. Cole ask about Friday's dismissal?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'She asked what time dismissal was on Friday.'

questions.q: Why does Mrs. Cole need to talk to the nurse?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown says she needs the nurse about the allergy medicine.

questions.q: What did Hafsa give Mrs. Cole?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I gave her the school email.'

questions.q: When will Mr. Brown call Mrs. Cole?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'I will call her back this afternoon.'

writing.promptTr: Bir velinin sana sorduğu soruları öğretmene not olarak aktar. Dolaylı soru kullan (asked if / asked where / wanted to know whether).
writing.promptEn: Write a short note to a teacher. Report the questions a parent asked you.
frames: Dear Ms. Park, a parent came today.
writing.model: Dear Ms. Park, a parent came to the office today. Her name was Mrs. Rivera. She asked if her son had been absent last week. She also wanted to know how he was doing in reading. Then she asked whether the school offered extra help. She asked when the next conference was, too. I told her that Mr. Brown would email her. She also asked if the school had a bus on Fridays, and I said that I did not know. She seemed a little worried, but she was very polite. Please call her if you have time. Thank you, Hafsa
checklistTr: Dolaylı sorularda if / whether / wh- kelimesinden sonra düz cümle sırası var mı?
Fiilleri bir adım geçmişe kaydırdın mı?
Soru işareti koymadın, değil mi (dolaylı soru nokta ile biter)?

examSet.q: "Do you work here?" → The woman asked me if I ___ there.
examSet.whyTr: Dolaylı soru: if + özne + geçmişe kayan fiil.

examSet.q: "What time does the bell ring?" → He asked what time the bell ___.
examSet.whyTr: Do/does düşer, fiil Past Simple olur.

examSet.q: She asked me ___ I could come on Monday.
Mr. Brown said, "The test is tomorrow." → Mr. Brown said that the test was ___.
examSet.whyTr: tomorrow → the next day (önceki gün konusu).

examSet.q: Linda ___ me that the store was closed.
My neighbor, ___ son goes to Lincoln School, is very friendly.
Daniel was ___ yesterday because he was sick. He did not come to school.
Which word means almost the same as "concern" (noun)?
The nurse must know about a child's ___. Some foods can make him very sick.
Lucas's reading is much better this year. His teacher says he has made great ___.

Mrs. Lee asked if her daughter was behaving well. The teacher said that she was very polite and helped other students.

What did Mrs. Lee want to know?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'asked if her daughter was behaving well'.
